title: Enforce fail-closed single-class character boundary
description: Implement ADR 0018 shared validation so the current schema and deterministic services reject multiclass-shaped state instead of silently flattening it. Guard character-sheet persistence/import and load/use, creation finalization, progression/level-up, F4 spell slots, and F7 Hit Dice. Expose UnsupportedCharacterBuildError with MULTICLASS_UNSUPPORTED and actionable CLI/model-facing diagnostics. Existing valid schema-v1 single-class sheets remain compatible.
design: Follow docs/adr/0018-single-class-engine-boundary.md section 7. Keep the guard system-aware and shared; do not scatter one-off classes-field checks. Known multiclass-shaped extension fields are not ignored. This bead establishes the precondition F4/F7/F8 may rely on; it does not implement multiclassing.
acceptance_criteria: A shared validator accepts canonical one-class sheets and rejects multiple-class/per-class-level shapes, mismatched subclasses, invalid levels, and alternate advancement targets; persistence/import, creation finalization, level-up preview/apply, F4 slot operations, and F7 Hit Dice operations invoke it before deriving state; failures use typed code MULTICLASS_UNSUPPORTED and are surfaced without flattening, repair, or model adjudication; representative store/import/creation/progression/slot/Hit-Dice tests prove fail-closed behavior; no schema migration is introduced for valid schema-v1 sheets.
notes: Review follow-up: validate advancement transport inputs at guided/preview/apply boundaries and inspect nested draft selections.
close_reason: Review follow-up complete: advancement inputs and nested draft selections now fail closed; full verify:worktree passed.
